sections.text:
-Ability Power 220. Damages all enemies 3 times with time-elemental physical damage at success of 75 points.
-Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Removes damage reflect, continued heal, and damage-reducing effects from all enemies.
-Removes buffs from all enemies.
-Casts awaken on your character.
